summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Defense to provide $1,000,000 annually from 2027 to 2030 to the National Diaper Bank Network to establish a Military Family Diaper Fund, which will distribute diapers and diapering supplies to military families in need, contingent on the Network providing matching funds or in-kind contributions.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the Secretary of Defense to provide funds for a military family diaper fund, which is a specific allocation of resources within the defense budget to support military families. This directly impacts military spending by adding a new expenditure.
